tags.name: Scheduled Events
tags.description: Endpoints for listing, retrieving, and canceling scheduled events (booked meetings).

tags.name: Invitees
tags.description: Endpoints for listing, retrieving, and creating invitees on scheduled events.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of scheduled events for the specified user or organization. Scheduled events represent booked meetings with start and end times, locations, and associated invitees.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The URI of the user whose scheduled events to list.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: The URI of the organization whose scheduled events to list.

parameters.name: min_start_time
parameters.description: Only return events starting on or after this time, in UTC format.

parameters.name: max_start_time
parameters.description: Only return events starting before this time, in UTC format.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order for results. Use start_time:asc or start_time:desc.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: A token for fetching the next page of results from a previous paginated response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of scheduled events

items.description: A scheduled event represents a booked meeting with a specific start time, end time, location, and associated invitees.

uri.description: The canonical URI of the scheduled event resource.

name.description: The name of the scheduled event.

status.description: The current status of the scheduled event.

start_time.description: The start time of the event in UTC.

end_time.description: The end time of the event in UTC.

event_type.description: The URI of the event type this event was created from.

location.description: The location configuration for a scheduled event, specifying where the meeting takes place.

type.description: The type of location (e.g., physical, outbound_call, inbound_call, google_conference, zoom, microsoft_teams_conference, custom).

location.description: The location details, such as an address or phone number.

join_url.description: The URL to join the meeting for virtual locations.

status.description: The status of the conference link generation.

invitees_counter.description: A count of invitees by status.

limit.description: The maximum number of invitees allowed.

cancellation.description: Information about a canceled event or invitee, including who canceled and the reason.

canceled_by.description: The name or identifier of who canceled the event.

reason.description: The reason provided for the cancellation.

canceler_type.description: Whether the host or invitee canceled.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the cancellation occurred.
The timestamp when the event was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the event was last updated.

user.description: The URI of the event member.

user_email.description: The email of the event member.

user_name.description: The name of the event member.

event_memberships.description: The list of users who are members (hosts) of this event.

email.description: The email address of the guest.

updated_at.description: When the guest record was last updated.

event_guests.description: Additional guests invited to the event.

pagination.description: Pagination information for paginated list responses.

count.description: The number of results in the current page.

next_page.description: The URL of the next page of results, if available.

previous_page.description: The URL of the previous page of results, if available.

next_page_token.description: The token to fetch the next page of results.

previous_page_token.description: The token to fetch the previous page of results.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of invitees for a specific scheduled event. Invitee data includes name, email, timezone, and answers to custom questions from the booking page.

parameters.name: event_uuid
parameters.description: The UUID of the scheduled event.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order for results. Use created_at:asc or created_at:desc.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of results to return per page.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: A token for fetching the next page of results from a previous paginated response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of invitees

items.description: An invitee is a person who has booked or been booked for a scheduled event, with their contact information and booking details.

uri.description: The canonical URI of the invitee resource.

email.description: The email address of the invitee.

first_name.description: The first name of the invitee.

last_name.description: The last name of the invitee.

name.description: The full name of the invitee.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone of the invitee.

event.description: The URI of the associated scheduled event.

text_reminder_number.description: The phone number for text reminders.

rescheduled.description: Whether this invitee was rescheduled from a previous event.

old_invitee.description: The URI of the previous invitee if this was rescheduled.

new_invitee.description: The URI of the new invitee if this invitee was rescheduled.

cancel_url.description: The URL for the invitee to cancel the event.

reschedule_url.description: The URL for the invitee to reschedule the event.

routing_form_submission.description: The URI of the routing form submission that led to this booking.

cancellation.description: Information about a canceled event or invitee, including who canceled and the reason.

canceled_by.description: The name or identifier of who canceled the event.

reason.description: The reason provided for the cancellation.

canceler_type.description: Whether the host or invitee canceled.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the cancellation occurred.

payment.description: Payment information if the event type requires payment.

question.description: The text of the custom question.

answer.description: The invitees answer to the question.

position.description: The display position of the question.

questions_and_answers.description: The invitees answers to custom questions on the booking page.

tracking.description: UTM and tracking parameters captured at booking time.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the invitee was last updated.
